question: Does the exact landed AG R2 learned-factor recipe, conditioned only on one frozen source-native session geometry factor per capture session, meet absolute factor accuracy, coverage, UNKNOWN and uncertainty-calibration gates on three untouched capture sessions from an independent RGB-D/IMU sensor rig?

data_partitions.identity_basis: Seven official archives are bound by URL, byte count and SHA-256; three capture sessions and disjoint twelve-calibration plus twelve-score frame rosters per session are fixed by an outcome-blind deterministic rank rule.
data_partitions.disjointness_evidence: The exact selected sequence IDs have zero matches in current files and all repository history through 07ab1ba2 with textconv disabled; the current AG recipe ancestors are ICL synthetic and TUM Freiburg, and the selected source uses the distinct ETH3D custom active-stereo RGB-D/IMU rig. This proves repository-level recipe, session and sensor separation, not unknown upstream foundation-pretraining non-exposure.

source_adapter_contract.rgb_and_depth_pairing: Use official same-basename synchronized RGB/depth pairs from associated.txt; no nearest-neighbor reselection.
source_adapter_contract.intrinsics: Read fx, fy, cx, cy from each sequence calibration.txt and preserve the official undistorted pinhole convention.
source_adapter_contract.metric_depth: float32(uint16_depth) / 5000.0; zero, nonfinite, nonpositive and values outside 0.25 to 6.0 metres are source UNKNOWN.
source_adapter_contract.pose: Use the official camera-to-global training trajectory only after the raw score-frame prediction receipt is sealed.
source_adapter_contract.imu: Use imu.txt for the RGB/depth camera viewpoint and the hash-bound official camera-IMU calibration. An ambiguous axis, time or transform convention is NOT_EVALUABLE rather than guessed.
source_adapter_contract.source_truth_ceiling: Metric depth is A_SOURCE_NATIVE. Support, obstacle and boundary fields are deterministic B_GEOMETRY_ANCHORED_DERIVATION and cannot be called direct truth.
source_adapter_contract.orientation: LANDSCAPE_IDENTITY_ONLY; no outcome-informed crop, rotate, resize or frame exclusion.

session_geometry_contract.calibration_roster: The twelve lowest hash-ranked eligible identities per parent; disjoint from the twelve score identities.
session_geometry_contract.gravity_rule: Associate camera-viewpoint IMU samples through the hash-bound camera-IMU calibration and official trajectory, then robustly estimate one global gravity direction from calibration identities only. Ambiguous calibration, fewer than five associated samples per identity, or inconsistent orientation is NOT_EVALUABLE.
session_geometry_contract.support_identity_rule: Backproject calibration depth with bound K and pose, retain gravity-horizontal local surfaces, recover persistent world-height modes, and select the lowest persistent mode using the frozen F1 source-and-label geometry rules generalized from three to all twelve calibration identities without changing height bins or surface tolerances.
session_geometry_contract.camera_height_rule: One scalar per parent: median camera-to-lowest-persistent-support height over valid calibration identities; require 0.45 to 2.20 metres and calibration MAD at most 0.10 metre.
session_geometry_contract.application_order: First seal raw score-frame RGB+K model outputs; second open calibration-role source geometry and compute the one session factor; third apply the factor once with the frozen weighted-quantile q=0.75 support-threshold=0.0 anchor; fourth seal final factor tensors; only then open score-role source outcomes.
forbidden: score-frame depth or derived factor in session calibration
fallback to walking_xyz or sitting_rpy calibration

factor_ownership.claim_rule: A pass confirms only learned factor behavior conditioned on the declared one-time source context. It does not claim that camera height, gravity or support normal were independently predicted.

evaluation_contract.depth_residual: r = log(predicted_metric_depth_m) - log(source_metric_depth_m) on source-known AND prediction-known pixels.
evaluation_contract.depth_combined_error: mean(abs(r)) per frame, then parent mean.
evaluation_contract.depth_scale_error: abs(median(r)) per frame, then parent mean.
evaluation_contract.depth_shape_error: mean(abs(r - median(r))) per frame, then parent mean; this diagnostic alignment cannot modify saved prediction.
evaluation_contract.support_error: Brier score between predicted support probability and the frozen source-derived continuous support factor on jointly known pixels.
evaluation_contract.obstacle_error: Brier score between predicted obstacle-evidence probability and the frozen source-derived continuous obstacle factor on jointly known pixels.
evaluation_contract.boundary_error: Convert absolute predicted-versus-source boundary-distance error into camera angle as atan(error_px / sqrt(fx*fy)); aggregate only where source evidence and prediction are both known.
evaluation_contract.uncertainty_calibration: For depth, support and boundary separately report empirical absolute-residual coverage within predicted one-sigma and two-sigma and Spearman ordering between frozen predicted sigma strata and observed residual magnitude.
evaluation_contract.known_coverage: prediction-known AND source-known divided by source-known, separately by parent and factor.
evaluation_contract.unknown_rule: Source UNKNOWN is excluded from accuracy denominators and is never negative. Prediction UNKNOWN on source-known support lowers known coverage. Prediction known on source-UNKNOWN support is reported as unsupported-known diagnostic only and is neither correct nor incorrect.
evaluation_contract.no_easy_pool_rescue: All required factor gates must pass parent-macro and worst-parent rules; pooled pixels, another factor, or another parent cannot rescue failure.

constraints.description: This lock may download and hash opaque official archives and inspect public text metadata, but may not enumerate ZIP members, extract payloads, open RGB/depth/IMU/trajectory/calibration contents, run the model or create any factor result.
The bound metric checkpoint, factor checkpoint, residual bank and frozen hybrid recipe are immutable; no training, tuning, checkpoint choice or calibration on ETH3D is allowed.
Raw RGB+K score predictions must be sealed before calibration source geometry opens; final conditioned factors must be sealed before score-role depth, IMU, trajectory or derived labels open.
Session-geometry calibration identities and scored confirmation identities are disjoint by exact pair identity within each capture session.
Source UNKNOWN never becomes a negative label; prediction UNKNOWN lowers coverage and cannot be counted as an error-free omission.
K, gravity, support normal, camera height and the one-time scale factor retain source-context provenance and are excluded from learned-factor accuracy claims.
No baseline win, reducer state, clearance, occupancy, task utility, HTP or App output may enter a gate, selector, calibration or terminal decision.

Repository-level source, sensor, session and AG-recipe independence is established, but the unreleased upstream DepthART training recipe prevents a claim of proven foundation-pretraining non-exposure.
Exactly three preassigned independent ETH3D capture sessions must remain in the confirmation cohort.
constraints.rationale: Three sessions are the smallest declared cross-session cohort that permits parent-macro and worst-parent checks without pretending pixels are independent parents.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome protocol design and official sequence metadata only.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report every parent separately; do not recompute a two-parent pass if one parent is missing.
constraints.revision_policy: Any parent change requires a new protocol and new data identity before outcome access.

constraints.description: Every parent must contribute exactly twelve hash-ranked session-geometry calibration identities.
constraints.rationale: Twelve distributes the one-time geometry estimate across a session while matching the prior bounded AG seam frame budget.
constraints.calibration_source: Prior AG twelve-frame seam budget and outcome-blind resource bound.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report identity counts and rank tokens; no replacement identities after payload access.
constraints.revision_policy: Roster size or selection changes require a new pre-outcome evidence version.

constraints.description: Every parent must contribute exactly twelve scored identities disjoint from calibration identities.
constraints.rationale: Twelve per parent keeps compute bounded while preserving repeated observations inside each of three independent session units.
constraints.calibration_source: Prior AG twelve-frame seam budget and pre-outcome resource bound.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all thirty-six frame identities and all exclusions; do not replace failed frames.
constraints.revision_policy: Any score-roster change after payload access is forbidden for this evidence version.

constraints.description: Each parent must expose at least twenty-four metadata-valid synchronized pairs before calibration and score roles are assigned.
constraints.rationale: Twenty-four is exactly the nonoverlapping twelve-calibration plus twelve-score requirement; less data cannot support the frozen split.
constraints.calibration_source: Deterministic roster contract, before payload access.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report the count and terminate NOT_EVALUABLE rather than reducing either role.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold reduction; source insufficiency closes this evidence version.

constraints.description: Every calibration-only session camera-height estimate must lie in the frozen physically admissible interval.
constraints.rationale: This is the existing F1 source-support physical range; it rejects table or ceiling modes masquerading as the support surface.
constraints.calibration_source: Bound F1 source-and-label contract, not ETH3D outcomes.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report each parent estimate and mode receipt; any outside value is NOT_EVALUABLE, not clipped.
constraints.revision_policy: Physical range is immutable for this protocol version.

constraints.description: The worst parent calibration camera-height median absolute deviation must remain bounded.
constraints.rationale: A one-time session factor is only meaningful when calibration-frame height estimates agree within half of the frozen 0.20 m task clearance tolerance.
constraints.calibration_source: Frozen B0 clearance tolerance and pre-outcome robustness design.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report per-parent MAD and all valid calibration estimates; do not delete outliers after inspection.
constraints.revision_policy: No post-outcome relaxation; instability is NOT_EVALUABLE.

constraints.description: Every parent must retain enough source-native valid metric depth to support factor scoring.
constraints.rationale: A majority source-known denominator prevents an active-stereo sparsity pattern from making an easy or unrepresentative factor claim.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome data-adequacy design; no selected payload was opened.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report each parent and frame distribution; failure is NOT_EVALUABLE, never a model fail.
constraints.revision_policy: No denominator relaxation after source access.

constraints.description: Every parent must expose a nontrivial source-derived support denominator.
constraints.rationale: Ten percent is a minimum evaluability floor that prevents a tiny support patch from standing in for session-level support evidence.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome factor-denominator design and prior F1 support-validity mechanics.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report support coverage by parent and frame; failure is NOT_EVALUABLE.
constraints.revision_policy: No post-access factor dropping or denominator reduction.

constraints.description: Every parent must expose a nontrivial source-derived obstacle/boundary evidence denominator.
constraints.rationale: Five percent is a minimum evidence floor for a sparse geometric-boundary factor and prevents absent boundaries from yielding a vacuous pass.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome factor-denominator design and frozen F1 evidence-validity semantics.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report evidence coverage and boundary-seed counts by parent; failure is NOT_EVALUABLE.
constraints.revision_policy: No post-access factor dropping or denominator reduction.

constraints.description: Prediction-known metric depth must cover at least ninety percent of source-known metric depth on every parent.
constraints.rationale: This preserves the existing AG known-coverage floor and prevents selective abstention from hiding metric-depth error.
constraints.calibration_source: Frozen B0/B1 known-coverage contract, not a comparison baseline.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report coverage and valid-to-UNKNOWN by parent; no threshold sweep.
constraints.revision_policy: No post-outcome coverage relaxation.

constraints.description: Prediction-known support must cover at least sixty percent of source-known support on every parent.
constraints.rationale: The forty-percent UNKNOWN budget acknowledges derived support uncertainty while still requiring a majority of usable source-supported evidence.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome UNKNOWN budget informed by frozen F1 support validity, not ETH3D outcomes.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report known and UNKNOWN fractions per parent; no factor can be omitted.
constraints.revision_policy: No post-outcome coverage relaxation.

constraints.description: Prediction-known obstacle and boundary evidence must each cover at least half of their source-known support on every parent.
constraints.rationale: A fifty-percent floor prevents a sparse hard subset from carrying the boundary claim while retaining honest UNKNOWN behavior.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome factor coverage design and frozen UNKNOWN semantics.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report obstacle and boundary separately for every parent; no pooled rescue.
constraints.revision_policy: No post-outcome coverage relaxation or factor dropping.

constraints.description: Parent-macro absolute log metric-depth error after the one-time session factor must remain bounded.
constraints.rationale: A 0.25 log ratio is an absolute factor tolerance near a 28 percent multiplicative error and matches the prior AG camera-height macro bound without using baseline victory.
constraints.calibration_source: Consumed TUM factor diagnostics and the frozen Attempt17 absolute geometry envelope only.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report parent macro and all parent values; do not compare against or select by another model.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: No individual parent may exceed the absolute log metric-depth error ceiling.
constraints.rationale: The worst-parent ceiling blocks an easy-session macro rescue while remaining stricter than the prior 0.50 absolute scale bound.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome cross-session robustness design and prior AG absolute factor limits.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all parent values and the worst identity; no parent exclusion.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change or parent removal after outcome access.

constraints.description: Parent-macro scale-removed depth-shape absolute log error must remain bounded.
constraints.rationale: Shape receives a tighter bound than combined depth because the evaluation-only median scale component is reported separately and cannot excuse local geometry error.
constraints.calibration_source: Consumed Attempt17 depth-shape diagnostics, before ETH3D outcome access.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report aligned diagnostic and unaligned combined error together; aligned values never modify predictions.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: No parent may exceed the depth-shape absolute log error ceiling.
constraints.rationale: The 0.30 worst-parent bound prevents one sensor-domain session from being hidden by the other two.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome cross-session robustness design and consumed TUM shape diagnostics.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all parents; no parent removal.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: Parent-macro residual metric-scale absolute log error after the one-time factor must remain bounded.
constraints.rationale: This reuses the prior absolute 0.25 macro scale envelope and tests the conditioned recipe without asking it to beat a baseline.
constraints.calibration_source: Frozen Attempt17 absolute height/scale envelope and consumed session-anchor mechanics.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report per-parent residual scale; do not re-estimate a score-role alignment.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold or anchor change after outcome access.

constraints.description: No parent may exceed the residual metric-scale absolute log error ceiling.
constraints.rationale: This is the previously frozen worst-parent absolute geometry limit, now applied without a baseline comparison.
constraints.calibration_source: Frozen Attempt17 absolute height/scale envelope.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report every parent; no per-parent recalibration or exclusion.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold or anchor change after outcome access.

constraints.description: Parent-macro support probability Brier score must remain bounded on jointly known source-derived support.
constraints.rationale: The absolute proper-score ceiling is set from consumed factor diagnostics and rejects poorly calibrated support probabilities without requiring a prior win.
constraints.calibration_source: Consumed TUM factor diagnostics only; no ETH3D payload or output.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report parent and support-probability strata; no threshold sweep.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: No parent may exceed the support probability Brier ceiling.
constraints.rationale: A 0.25 worst-parent Brier ceiling is the uninformative balanced-probability boundary and prevents a failed session from being averaged away.
constraints.calibration_source: Proper-score interpretation and pre-outcome robustness design.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all parents and probability bins; no parent removal.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: Parent-macro obstacle-evidence Brier score must remain bounded on jointly known source-derived evidence.
constraints.rationale: Obstacle evidence is more selective than support, so the pre-outcome absolute ceiling is looser while remaining below the 0.25 uninformative balanced-probability boundary.
constraints.calibration_source: Consumed TUM obstacle-factor diagnostics and proper-score interpretation.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report parent and evidence-probability strata; no baseline comparison.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: No parent may exceed the obstacle-evidence Brier ceiling.
constraints.rationale: The worst-parent allowance is wider than macro but still forbids severe session collapse and pooled rescue.
constraints.calibration_source: Consumed TUM factor envelope and pre-outcome cross-session robustness design.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all parents; no parent removal or class rebalance after access.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: Parent-macro camera-angular boundary-distance error must remain bounded after intrinsics normalization.
constraints.rationale: Camera angle, unlike raw pixels, is comparable across sensors; 0.02 rad corresponds to about two centimetres lateral error at one metre.
constraints.calibration_source: Physical geometry interpretation and frozen intrinsics-aware factor design before ETH3D access.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Also report raw pixels and depth strata as diagnostics; only the frozen angular metric gates.
constraints.revision_policy: No metric or threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: No parent may exceed the camera-angular boundary-distance error ceiling.
constraints.rationale: Twice the macro tolerance permits session variation but prevents one scene from being hidden by other parents.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome cross-session robustness design and physical angular tolerance.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all parents and depth strata; no parent removal.
constraints.revision_policy: No metric or threshold change after outcome access.

constraints.description: Across depth, support and boundary, the worst factor-family absolute deviation of empirical one-sigma coverage from Gaussian nominal coverage must remain bounded.
constraints.rationale: The tolerance tests absolute uncertainty semantics while allowing bounded finite-cohort variation and uses no homoscedastic baseline win.
constraints.calibration_source: Gaussian one-sigma nominal coverage and pre-outcome finite-cohort tolerance.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report each family and parent; no post-outcome sigma rescaling.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold or uncertainty recalibration after outcome access.

constraints.description: Across depth, support and boundary, the worst factor-family absolute deviation of empirical two-sigma coverage from Gaussian nominal coverage must remain bounded.
constraints.rationale: The two-sigma tail receives a tighter absolute deviation because severe undercoverage is consequential and baseline-relative NLL is forbidden.
constraints.calibration_source: Gaussian two-sigma nominal coverage and pre-outcome finite-cohort tolerance.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report undercoverage and overcoverage separately by family and parent; no sigma rescaling.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold or uncertainty recalibration after outcome access.

constraints.description: Every required uncertainty family must retain positive parent-macro rank ordering between predicted sigma and observed absolute residual.
constraints.rationale: A moderate positive rank relationship is a direct absolute informativeness gate and avoids the arbitrary baseline-NLL comparison that the successor forbids.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome uncertainty-ordering design and frozen factor semantics.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report family-parent rho values and ties; undefined rho is NOT_EVALUABLE, not silently dropped.
constraints.revision_policy: No threshold, binning or family change after outcome access.

not_evaluable_conditions: archive, member, calibration, transform, roster or implementation binding failure before valid scoring
any source adequacy gate G01 through G09 fails
any required denominator is zero, missing, nonfinite or undefined
a required uncertainty-family Spearman value is undefined
terminal_mapping.confirm_fail_conditions: After valid execution and evaluable source support, any model gate G10 through G27 fails on parent-macro or worst-parent rules.
terminal_mapping.confirm_pass_conditions: Execution is valid, every source gate G01 through G09 passes, every model gate G10 through G27 passes, and all required receipts are hash-bound.

execution_authority.reason: The F2 question, data identity, source semantics and statistics are frozen, but the exact source adapter, roster freezer, prediction/truth firewall executor, independent validator, synthetic mutations and their file hashes do not exist yet.

successor_scope: Implement and independently validate the exact opaque-archive preflight, deterministic roster freeze, ETH3D source adapter, calibration-versus-score firewall, factor-only scorer and hash-bound one-shot command using synthetic fixtures and metadata only. Do not run model inference or open selected payload outcomes.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: On three preassigned ETH3D capture sessions, seal raw score-frame predictions, derive one session factor only from disjoint calibration identities, seal conditioned learned factors, then score absolute factor accuracy, known coverage, UNKNOWN and uncertainty without running the reducer.
experiment_design.resource_budget: Three parents; twelve calibration plus twelve score identities per parent; one model recipe; one source-context factor per parent; one future one-shot execution version.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop as NOT_EVALUABLE on source, transform, denominator or roster failure; stop as CONFIRM_FAIL on any evaluable learned-factor gate failure; never tune, replace parents, rerun on the same evidence version or advance to reducer/task/device work.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: The landed recipe separates learned metric/support/boundary factors from a deterministic adapter and already exposed metric-scale sensitivity; an independent sensor rig plus one declared source-native session factor directly tests whether factor behavior transfers without task-state selection.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Changes sensor rig and capture sessions while freezing learned checkpoints, calibration bank, recipe, absolute gates and reducer exclusion; only one predeclared session context factor is supplied from disjoint calibration identities.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates cross-sensor factor transfer from the prior single-TUM seam mechanics and localizes failure to depth, support, obstacle, boundary, coverage, UNKNOWN or uncertainty without reducer confounding.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Three ETH3D sessions with twelve disjoint calibration and twelve score identities each, evaluated once by parent-macro and worst-parent absolute gates.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Absolute log depth shape/scale/combined error, support and obstacle Brier, intrinsics-normalized boundary angular error, factor known coverage and UNKNOWN, and absolute one/two-sigma coverage plus sigma-residual ordering.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any valid/evaluable model gate fails; a required factor has insufficient source support; or source-context, truth firewall, identity or hash invariants cannot be established.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Seventy-two selected frame identities across three sessions, one immutable recipe and one future one-shot confirmation execution.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not tune or rerun after any selected payload or outcome access; preserve CONFIRM_FAIL or NOT_EVALUABLE as the terminal for this evidence version.
hypotheses.selection_reason: This is the exact current AG successor and the smallest repository-unconsumed sensor-domain test that preserves factor ownership and UNKNOWN semantics.

failure_learning.observation: No ZIP member, payload, model output, source outcome or confirmation metric has been opened or created.
failure_learning.inference: Only the cross-sensor question, exact opaque archives, deterministic roster rule, factor ownership, absolute metrics and terminal semantics are frozen.
alternative_explanations: A future NOT_EVALUABLE may reflect ETH3D calibration/frame-contract incompatibility rather than learned-factor failure.

A future CONFIRM_FAIL may reflect sensor-domain shift, unsupported foundation ancestry, session-anchor failure, factor-head failure or uncertainty miscalibration; the factor table must distinguish them.
reuse_candidates: Opaque archive hashes and public source metadata may be reused as source provenance, but accessed confirmation outcomes may never become confirmation data again.
failure_learning.information_gain: The lock removes Bonn ancestry leakage, baseline/reducer confounding and post-outcome threshold freedom before any selected source content is opened.

claim_ceiling: F2 protocol, data identity and statistical lock for repository-level independent ETH3D sensor/session transfer of learned AG factors conditioned on one source-native session geometry factor. It is NOT a confirmation result, does not prove zero upstream foundation-pretraining exposure, does not confirm source-given camera geometry as learned output, and gives no reducer, navigation, HTP, App, product or safety authority.
